name: telegram-automation
description: Dev/QA tooling for driving the real Telegram Web client as the operator, for testing aibridge end to end (§9). Not aibridge itself - same boundary scripts/dev-bridge.sh draws. One-time setup: `npm install && node login.js` (scan the QR code, Ctrl+C once status.txt says logged_in), then use send-command.js/check-topic.js.
